specName: Code Context Tools for AI Clients

decisions.decision: ccctx mcp is a subcommand dispatched before the CLI connects; golestan-code-mcp stays as an alias
decisions.why: the server must start with the database down and report outages per call; old registrations keep working
decisions.rejected: a separate ccctx-mcp script, or connecting at startup

decisions.decision: editable install (uv tool install --editable .) so PROJECT_ROOT/.env is found from any directory
decisions.why: no code change; environment already overrides .env for non-editable installs

decisions.decision: ranges stated in parameter descriptions and checked in the core, not schema ge/le; extra arguments forbidden
decisions.why: keeps refusals as structured unavailable results shared with the CLI; a stale repos argument must not silently widen a search
decisions.rejected: schema minimum/maximum, which pydantic turns into isError traces

decisions.decision: each description: question answered, when to prefer it over its neighbor, what returns, next-step hint
decisions.why: tool choice is decided by comparing descriptions; naming the neighbor prevents search-vs-get_symbol and callers-vs-impact confusion

decisions.decision: snippet = first 10 lines / 800 chars of stored source, read in the existing hit query
decisions.why: a definition's opening lines identify it; no extra round trip
decisions.rejected: lines around keyword matches, which natural-language queries often lack

decisions.decision: language and limit filtered inside semantic.search with the repository scope and pool widening
decisions.why: CLI and tool stay identical and a narrow filter still fills limit

decisions.decision: get_symbol serves stored source via graph.definitions with the _targets name rules, 5 matches, 400 lines
decisions.why: matches what was indexed, never touches the repository, names behave the same as in find_callers
decisions.rejected: reading files from disk; unbounded match lists

decisions.decision: tool choice measured with claude -p, --tools "" and stream-json over five questions
decisions.why: removes file access and records the exact tool order

decisions.decision: extra arguments refused by subclassing each tool's FastMCP arg model with extra=forbid after registration
decisions.why: FastMCP silently drops undeclared arguments, so a stale repos would widen a search; the schema also advertises additionalProperties false

decisions.decision: one _answer helper for check-before-connect, connect, migrate and the unavailable envelope for every tool but list_repositories
decisions.why: the same refusal shape for all tools without repeating the try blocks

decisions.decision: ccctx mcp imports the server lazily inside its branch
decisions.why: only that command needs the MCP library, other commands keep their startup

decisions.decision: outage reason stays the driver's message (db.describe), contract wording corrected
decisions.why: matches the step 7 tools and carries no password

plan.summary: plan, research (R1-R8), data-model and contracts (tools.md, cli.md) for six MCP tools, ccctx mcp, search language/limit/snippet and get_symbol; no schema change
plan.key_finding: FastMCP ignores unknown arguments and turns schema bounds into isError traces, so ranges and extra-key rejection must be handled deliberately

tasks.summary: 13 tasks: setup (version), foundational wave of 4 (search core, graph.definitions), tools phase US1-US3 (server.py), client phase US4 (cli.py), polish (live checks, tool-choice eval, README, suites)

implement.summary: six read-only MCP tools (search_code, get_symbol, find_callers, find_callees, impact_of, list_repositories) started by ccctx mcp; search gains language, limit and snippets; version 1.0.0

approach: Reshape the stdio server into six read-only tools with model-oriented descriptions, started by ccctx mcp. Extend semantic.search with language, limit and snippets (and ccctx search with matching flags), add graph.definitions for get_symbol over stored source, and rename the step 7 graph tools. No schema change; version 1.0.0.

concerns.note: server.py reaches into FastMCP's private _tool_manager to forbid extra arguments; an SDK upgrade could change it, and test_unknown_arguments_are_refused would catch that
test files that hit the database delete every t-% repository on teardown, so running two test files concurrently (as parallel workers did) makes them fail at random; sequential runs are clean
the tool-choice evaluation is a manual claude -p run, not a repeatable test; results recorded in the README
